expectations.text: Adjusts site-visit depth to the stated inability to travel without treating a desk check as a substitute for a pre-signature visit.
expectations.evidence: The 'No site visits' section adapts the visit to the travel limit and ranks the options. Best is a local proxy walking the marked sheet: WiFi test, outlets, load-in, storage, accessible route, meeting the on-day contact. Next is a live video walkthrough. It says 'A signed venue with no walkthrough breaks the skill's rule. A visit after signature is worthless,' and asks whether the user can give 1–2 hours to one finalist. It ranks a desk check below a walkthrough and warns it 'returns no marked sheet and no tested WiFi.' It loses a point because the desk check is still listed as a 'Fallback.' I

expectations.text: Adjusts site-visit depth to the stated inability to travel without treating a desk check as a substitute for a pre-signature visit.
expectations.evidence: The response adapts to the travel limit with a proxy visit: a local attendee, co-organizer or Castellan staff member spends 30 minutes on site with a checklist and photos. It also asks for real-time video tours. However, Step 5 presents a venue-hosted video tour as an equal alternative ('Or ask for a venue-hosted video tour at a time you pick'). It reserves an in-person visit for the case where 'the shortlist is down to one venue and you cannot decide.' The time budget moves from 'Video tours, proxy visit' straight to 'Pick, negotiate, contract', with no required physical check before signing.
